about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Freelander 2.0 Di / Td4 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Freelander 2.0 Di / Td4 was fitted to the first-generation Freelander (L314) from 1997 to 2006. Early cars used the L-Series — an engine developed by Land Rover and fitted to the Freelander until around 2001. Later cars switched to the BMW M47D20, a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel shared with the BMW 3 and 5 Series of the same era. This engine was carried over into the second-generation Freelander (L359) when it launched in 2006 — a testament to its strength. The Freelander is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Land Rover Freelander 2.0 Di / Td4 Engine Codes L-Series (early, 1997–2001) A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the earliest Freelander 2.0 Di models. A solid engine for its time, though specific rebuild parts are now harder to source than the later M47D20. Check Your L-Series Freelander → [link to quote form] BMW M47D20 (later Td4, 2001–2006) The M47D20 — BMW's 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel — is the more common engine in Freelander Td4s. It's robust but known for timing chain stretch and injector seal leaks over time. We replace timing chain components, bearings and gaskets as standard on every M47D20 rebuild. Check Your M47D20 Freelander → [link to quote form] Land Rover Freelander 2.0 Di / Td4 Engine Compatibility Because the Freelander 2.0 Di / Td4 spans two distinct engines under one variant name, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming M47D20 parts will work on an L-Series car — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Related Land Rover Freelander Variants Looking for a different Freelander engine? We also cover: [Land Rover Freelander 1.8i Engine →] · [Land Rover Freelander 2.5 V6 Engine →] · [Land Rover Freelander TD4 (L359) Engine →] · [Land Rover Freelander eD4 Engine →] · [Land Rover Freelander Si4 Engine →] · [Land Rover Freelander SD4 Engine →] [← View All Land Rover Freelander Engines] Frequently Asked Questions What engine does the Land Rover Freelander 2.0 Di / Td4 use? It depends on the year. Early cars (roughly 1997 to 2001) use the L-Series diesel. Later cars (roughly 2001 to 2006) use the BMW M47D20 — the same engine found in BMW 3 and 5 Series of that era. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has. How much does a Land Rover Freelander 2.0 Di / Td4 engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £1,900, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Freelander? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the L-Series or the BMW M47D20 before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild L-Series Freelander 2.0 Di engines? Yes. The L-Series was fitted to early Freelander 2.0 Di models, and we rebuild them to the same standard as the later M47D20 units. Do you rebuild BMW M47D20 Freelander 2.0 Td4 engines? Yes. We replace timing chain components, bearings and gaskets as standard on every M47D20 rebuild. Do you supply used Freelander 2.0 Di / Td4 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Freelander if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Freelander 2.0 Di / Td4 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Freelander owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.codeHighlight: L-Series (early Di) or BMW M47D20 (later Td4)
cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Freelander 2.0 Di / Td4 from 2023 to present. The L-Series (early Di) or BMW M47D20 (later Td4) features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older L-Series (early Di) or BMW M47D20 (later Td4) V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every L-Series (early Di) or BMW M47D20 (later Td4) rebuild.
